# Sydney Brake Inspection Request for a 2018 Honda Civic

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg

You need a **non-urgent brake diagnosis** for a 2018 Honda Civic with **78,000 km**. The symptoms point to a brake-system inspection rather than immediate parts replacement, and your **AUD 250 diagnosis-only budget** is a good filter for booking the right shop.

# Service Request Draft and Mechanic Checklist

## Service request you can send
**Subject:** Brake squeal and longer stopping distance — 2018 Honda Civic

Hello,

I’d like to book a **non-urgent inspection** for my **2018 Honda Civic** in Sydney, Australia, sometime between **2026-05-04 and 2026-05-18**.

The car has **78,000 km** on it and I’ve noticed:
- A **squeaking noise when braking**
- A **slightly longer stopping distance**

I’m looking for a **diagnosis only** within a **budget of AUD 250** if possible. Please check the brake system and let me know what is causing the noise and reduced braking performance before any repair work is approved.

Please confirm:
- Availability within the requested date range
- Diagnostic fee
- What inspection items are included
- Whether you can provide a written report before any parts are replaced

Thank you.

## Likely inspection items
- Brake pads for wear, glazing, uneven wear, or contamination
- Brake rotors/discs for scoring, lip wear, heat spots, or warping
- Calipers and slide pins for sticking or uneven movement
- Brake pad hardware, clips, shims, and anti-rattle components
- Brake fluid level and condition
- Brake hoses and visible leaks
- Wheel bearings and suspension play that could affect braking feel
- Tyres and tyre pressure, since poor grip can lengthen stopping distance
- ABS warning lights or stored fault codes if the shop includes scanning

## Mechanic comparison checklist
Use this to compare quotes before booking.

| Checkpoint | What to confirm | Good sign | Red flag |
|---|---|---|---|
| Diagnosis fee | Ask for the inspection price upfront | Clear fixed fee within budget | Vague or open-ended pricing |
| Scope | Ask what the inspection includes | Pads, rotors, calipers, fluid, tyres, road test | “We’ll see once it’s on the hoist” only |
| Written findings | Ask for a written report or call-back | Photos or notes before repairs | Pressure to approve repairs immediately |
| Brake expertise | Ask if they regularly service Honda brakes | Specific brake-system experience | General answers with no detail |
| Approval process | Ask before any parts are replaced | No work without authorization | Surprise add-ons |
| Turnaround | Ask how long diagnosis takes | Same-day or next-day inspection | Long delay for a simple diagnosis |
| Test drive | Ask if they road test the car | Yes, if safe and appropriate | No road test at all |
| Warranty | Ask if diagnostic fee is credited toward repair | Clear policy in writing | Unclear or changing terms |

## Recommended booking wording
If you want a shorter version for an online form, use this:

**Brake squeak and longer stopping distance on 2018 Honda Civic, 78,000 km. Requesting non-urgent diagnosis only between 2026-05-04 and 2026-05-18 in Sydney. Budget up to AUD 250 for inspection. Please check pads, rotors, calipers, fluid, and any related brake or tyre issues before recommending repairs.**
